It looks like the import statements (import marimo as mo and import numpy as np) ended up at the bottom of your cell, but Python reads code from top to bottom-so it tries to use np before it knows what it is!
To fix this, just move those two import lines right to the top of the cell so it looks like this:
import marimo as mo
import numpy as np

def get_node_matrix():
    return np.random.randint(1, 10, size=(3, 3))

matrix_data = get_node_matrix()
spatial_grid = mo.ui.table(matrix_data.tolist())
spatial_grid

Clear out anything else below that, re-run the cell, and your grid will render properly!
